pages.text: It was midsummer. Cicadas sang, and the yard baked in the heat.
"I want a nap somewhere cool." Mumu fanned himself. Dodo sprang up. "I know the coolest spot!"
Dodo led him to the middle of the field. "A prime spot! Wind comes from every side!"
The bright sun baked the tops of their heads. Both sweated heavily.
"Then under the bridge! Plenty of shade!" Dodo ran beneath it.
It was shady, but clunk-a-clunk, clunk-a-clunk! The waterwheel echoed loudly.
"The lullaby... is a bit loud." Dodo covered her ears with her wings.
Mumu looked at the willow by the stream. Long branches swayed, touching the water. Its shade looked cool as water.
They flopped into the willow shade. A gentle breeze slipped between the branches.
Snore, snore. Oh, Dodo was asleep already. "I found the prime spot... of course..." Mumu giggled at her sleepy words, then drifted off too.
